mapper.sql: select kp.id, kp.parent_id, kp.exam_subject_id, kp.syllabus_version_id, kp.importance from cm_knowledge_point kp where kp.syllabus_version_id = #{syllabusVersionId} and kp.del_flag = '0' and kp.status = '0'

r.question_type = 'CHOICE' and r.answer is not null and jsonb_typeof(r.answer) = 'object' and jsonb_exists(r.answer, 'schema_version') and jsonb_exists(r.answer, 'answer_type') and jsonb_exists(r.answer, 'selection_mode') and jsonb_exists(r.answer, 'value') and r.answer->>'answer_type' = 'option_keys' and r.answer->>'selection_mode' = 'single' and jsonb_typeof(r.answer->'value') = 'array' and jsonb_array_length(r.answer->'value') = 1 and exists (select 1 from cm_question_option o where o.question_revision_id = r.id) and not exists ( select 1 from jsonb_array_elements_text(r.answer->'value') a(label) where not exists (select 1 from cm_question_option o where o.question_revision_id = r.id and o.option_label = a.label)) and exists ( select 1 from cm_question_knowledge leaf_qk join cm_knowledge_point leaf on leaf.id = leaf_qk.knowledge_point_id where leaf_qk.question_revision_id = r.id and leaf_qk.exam_subject_id = leaf.exam_subject_id and leaf.syllabus_version_id = #{syllabusVersionId} and leaf.del_flag = '0' and leaf.status = '0' and not exists (select 1 from cm_knowledge_point child where child.parent_id = leaf.id and child.del_flag = '0' and child.status = '0'))

with recursive scope as ( select id, parent_id, exam_subject_id, syllabus_version_id from cm_knowledge_point where id = #{knowledgePointId} and syllabus_version_id = #{syllabusVersionId} and del_flag = '0' and status = '0' union all select child.id, child.parent_id, child.exam_subject_id, child.syllabus_version_id from cm_knowledge_point child join scope parent on child.parent_id = parent.id where child.del_flag = '0' and child.status = '0' ), latest as ( select distinct on (r.question_id) r.* from cm_question_revision r where r.status = 'published' order by r.question_id, r.revision_no desc, r.id desc ), qualified as ( select distinct q.id question_id, r.id revision_id, root.exam_subject_id from scope root join cm_question_knowledge qk on qk.knowledge_point_id = root.id and qk.exam_subject_id = root.exam_subject_id join cm_question q on q.id = qk.question_id and q.del_flag = '0' join latest r on r.question_id = q.id and r.id = qk.question_revision_id where )
mapper.select: select g.id, g.certification_id, c.certification_name, g.syllabus_version_id, sv.version_name syllabus_version_name, g.row_version, g.status goal_status, c.status certification_status, g.target_exam_year, g.target_exam_month, exists ( select 1 from cm_learning_session s join cm_assessment_report ar on ar.session_id = s.id and ar.user_id = g.user_id join cm_overall_profile op on op.user_id = g.user_id and op.goal_id = g.id where s.user_id = g.user_id and s.goal_id = g.id and s.session_type = 'initial_diagnosis' and s.status = 'completed' and ar.status = 'available' ) onboarding_complete from cm_user_goal g join cm_exam_certification c on c.id = g.certification_id join cm_syllabus_version sv on sv.id = g.syllabus_version_id where g.user_id = #{userId} and g.status in ('active','paused') order by case g.status when 'active' then 0 else 1 end, g.update_time desc, g.id desc limit 1

with nodes as (), bounds as ( select max(tree_depth) max_depth from cm_knowledge_point where syllabus_version_id = #{syllabusVersionId} and del_flag = '0' and status = '0' ) select case when coalesce(max_depth,0) < 3 then 1 else 0 end + (select count(*) from nodes n join cm_knowledge_point kp on kp.id = n.id where kp.tree_depth <= max_depth - 2 and (n.importance is null or n.importance not in (1,2,3))) from bounds

with recursive nodes as (), bounds as ( select max(tree_depth) max_depth from cm_knowledge_point where syllabus_version_id=#{syllabusVersionId} and del_flag='0' and status='0' ), visible as ( select kp.* from cm_knowledge_point kp join nodes n on n.id = kp.id cross join bounds where kp.tree_depth <= bounds.max_depth - 2 ), latest as ( select distinct on (r.question_id) r.* from cm_question_revision r where r.status='published' order by r.question_id,r.revision_no desc,r.id desc ), descendants as ( select v.id ancestor_id, v.id descendant_id, v.exam_subject_id from visible v union all select d.ancestor_id, child.id, d.exam_subject_id from descendants d join cm_knowledge_point child on child.parent_id=d.descendant_id where child.syllabus_version_id=#{syllabusVersionId} and child.del_flag='0' and child.status='0' ), question_counts as ( select v.id knowledge_point_id, count(distinct q.id) question_count from visible v join descendants closure on closure.ancestor_id=v.id join cm_knowledge_point descendant on descendant.id=closure.descendant_id join cm_question_knowledge qk on qk.knowledge_point_id=descendant.id and qk.exam_subject_id=descendant.exam_subject_id join cm_question q on q.id=qk.question_id and q.del_flag='0' join latest r on r.id=qk.question_revision_id and r.question_id=q.id where group by v.id ) select v.id, v.parent_id, v.exam_subject_id, es.subject_name, case es.subject_code when 'COMPREHENSIVE' then 1 when 'CASE_ANALYSIS' then 2 when 'ESSAY' then 3 else 99 end subject_order, v.syllabus_number, v.syllabus_title, v.tree_depth, v.sort_order, v.importance, coalesce(qc.question_count,0) question_count, kp.current_direct_ability, coalesce(kp.profile_status,'unassessed') profile_status, coalesce(kp.confidence_level,'unassessed') confidence_level from visible v join cm_exam_subject es on es.id=v.exam_subject_id left join question_counts qc on qc.knowledge_point_id=v.id left join cm_knowledge_profile kp on kp.user_id=#{userId} and kp.goal_id=#{goalId} and kp.knowledge_point_id=v.id order by subject_order, v.sort_order, v.id

with nodes as (), bounds as ( select max(tree_depth) max_depth from cm_knowledge_point where syllabus_version_id=#{syllabusVersionId} and del_flag='0' and status='0' ), visible as ( select kp.* from cm_knowledge_point kp join nodes n on n.id=kp.id cross join bounds where kp.tree_depth <= bounds.max_depth - 2 ) select v.id,v.parent_id,v.exam_subject_id,v.syllabus_number,v.syllabus_title,v.tree_depth,v.sort_order,v.importance from visible v where v.id=#{knowledgePointId} and v.tree_depth in (2,3)

select q.question_id, q.revision_id, q.exam_subject_id, coalesce(nullif(btrim(base.evidence_group_key), ''), concat('Q:', q.question_id)) evidence_group_key, r.question_type,coalesce(r.difficulty, 'medium') difficulty,r.estimated_seconds,r.stem,r.analysis,r.answer::text answer_json, coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('label',o.option_label,'content',o.option_text,'sortOrder',o.sort_order) order by o.sort_order,o.id) from cm_question_option o where o.question_revision_id=r.id),'[]')::text options_json, coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('sourceUrl',im.source_url,'storagePath',im.storage_path,'altText',im.alt_text,'sortOrder',im.image_order) order by im.image_order,im.id) from cm_question_image im where im.question_revision_id=r.id),'[]')::text images_json, coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('knowledgePointId',leaf.id::text,'knowledgePointName',leaf.syllabus_title,'examSubjectId',leaf.exam_subject_id::text,'relationRole','tested','sortOrder',leaf.sort_order) order by leaf.id) from (select distinct kp.id,kp.syllabus_title,kp.exam_subject_id,kp.sort_order from cm_question_knowledge qk join cm_knowledge_point kp on kp.id=qk.knowledge_point_id where qk.question_revision_id=r.id and qk.exam_subject_id=kp.exam_subject_id and kp.syllabus_version_id=#{syllabusVersionId} and kp.del_flag='0' and kp.status='0' and not exists (select 1 from cm_knowledge_point c where c.parent_id=kp.id and c.del_flag='0' and c.status='0')) leaf),'[]')::text knowledge_json, '{}'::text grading_rules_json, 1.00 max_score from qualified q join cm_question base on base.id=q.question_id join cm_question_revision r on r.id=q.revision_id order by q.question_id
select id from cm_profile_rule_version where status='published'
select id,payload_hash,status,resource_id,response_body::text from cm_idempotency_record where action_code='START_KNOWLEDGE_PRACTICE' and request_id=#{requestId}
mapper.insert: insert into cm_idempotency_record(id,action_code,request_id,payload_hash,status,expires_time) values(#{id},'START_KNOWLEDGE_PRACTICE',#{requestId},#{payloadHash},'processing',now()+interval '24 hours') on conflict do nothing

insert into cm_learning_session(id,user_id,goal_id,exam_subject_id,session_type,status,rule_version_id,request_id, certification_id,syllabus_version_id,target_exam_year,target_exam_month,row_version) values(#{id},#{userId},#{goal.id},#{subjectId},'self_practice','created',#{ruleVersionId},#{requestId}, #{goal.certificationId},#{goal.syllabusVersionId},#{goal.targetExamYear},#{goal.targetExamMonth},0) on conflict do nothing
mapper.select: select s.id,s.user_id,s.goal_id,s.request_id,count(sq.id) total_count from cm_learning_session s left join cm_session_question sq on sq.session_id=s.id where s.user_id=#{userId} and s.goal_id=#{goalId} and s.session_type='self_practice' and s.status in ('created','in_progress') group by s.id order by s.create_time desc,s.id desc limit 1
select s.id,s.user_id,s.goal_id,s.request_id,count(sq.id) total_count from cm_learning_session s left join cm_session_question sq on sq.session_id=s.id where s.request_id=#{requestId} group by s.id

select s.id,s.user_id,s.goal_id,s.request_id,count(sq.id) total_count from cm_learning_session s left join cm_session_question sq on sq.session_id=s.id where s.id=#{sessionId} and s.user_id=#{userId} group by s.id
mapper.update: update cm_idempotency_record set status='succeeded',resource_type='cm_learning_session',resource_id=#{sessionId}, response_status=200,response_body=#{responseBody}::jsonb,update_time=now() where id=#{id} and status='processing'
mapper.select: select s.id,s.user_id,s.goal_id,s.rule_version_id,s.status,count(distinct sq.id)::int total_count, count(distinct a.id) filter (where a.status='submitted')::int submitted_count from cm_learning_session s left join cm_session_question sq on sq.session_id=s.id left join cm_question_attempt a on a.session_question_id=sq.id and a.user_id=s.user_id and a.status='submitted' where s.id=#{sessionId} and s.user_id=#{userId} and s.session_type in ('self_practice','reinforcement_practice') group by s.id
mapper.update: update cm_learning_session set status='in_progress',started_time=coalesce(started_time,now()), status_changed_time=now(),update_time=now() where id=#{sessionId} and user_id=#{userId} and session_type in ('self_practice','reinforcement_practice') and status='created'
mapper.select: select sq.question_order,a.id is not null submitted, case when a.id is null then null else aa.score_rate=1 end correct from cm_session_question sq left join cm_question_attempt a on a.session_question_id=sq.id and a.status='submitted' left join cm_attempt_answer aa on aa.attempt_id=a.id where sq.session_id=#{sessionId} order by sq.question_order

select sq.id session_question_id,s.id session_id,s.user_id,s.goal_id,s.rule_version_id, sq.exam_subject_id,sq.evidence_group_key,sq.difficulty_snapshot,sq.question_order,s.status session_status, (select count(*) from cm_session_question all_sq where all_sq.session_id=s.id)::int total_count, sq.presentation_snapshot::text,sq.grading_snapshot::text,sq.knowledge_snapshot::text, a.id attempt_id,aa.answer_data::text, case when aa.score_rate is null then null else aa.score_rate=1 end correct from cm_learning_session s join cm_session_question sq on sq.session_id=s.id left join cm_question_attempt a on a.session_question_id=sq.id and a.user_id=s.user_id and a.status='submitted' left join cm_attempt_answer aa on aa.attempt_id=a.id where s.id=#{sessionId} and s.user_id=#{userId} and s.session_type in ('self_practice','reinforcement_practice') and sq.question_order=#{questionOrder}
select id,user_id,goal_id,rule_version_id,status from cm_learning_session where id=#{sessionId} and user_id=#{userId} and session_type in ('self_practice','reinforcement_practice') for update
select id,payload_hash,status,resource_id,response_body::text from cm_idempotency_record where action_code=#{actionCode} and request_id=#{requestId}
mapper.insert: insert into cm_idempotency_record(id,action_code,request_id,payload_hash,status,expires_time) values(#{id},#{actionCode},#{requestId},#{payloadHash},'processing',now()+interval '24 hours') on conflict do nothing
mapper.update: update cm_idempotency_record set status='succeeded',resource_type=#{resourceType},resource_id=#{resourceId}, response_status=200,response_body=#{responseBody}::jsonb,update_time=now() where id=#{id} and status='processing'
mapper.insert: insert into cm_question_attempt(id,session_question_id,user_id,attempt_no,status,create_request_id,submit_request_id, submitted_time,timer_status,is_blank,is_skipped,is_first_attempt,is_repeat_attempt) values(#{id},#{sessionQuestionId},#{userId},1,'submitted',#{requestId},#{requestId},now(),'missing',false,false,true,false) on conflict do nothing

insert into cm_attempt_answer(id,attempt_id,answer_data,score,max_score,score_rate,grading_status,graded_time) values(#{id},#{attemptId},#{answerData}::jsonb,case when #{correct} then 1.00 else 0.00 end,1.00, case when #{correct} then 1.00000000 else 0.00000000 end,'graded',now())
insert into cm_error_record(id,user_id,goal_id,attempt_id,knowledge_point_id,evidence_group_key) values(#{id},#{userId},#{goalId},#{attemptId},#{knowledgePointId},#{groupKey}) on conflict do nothing
mapper.select: insert into cm_profile_settlement(id,user_id,goal_id,exam_subject_id,knowledge_point_id,settlement_type, source_session_id,source_attempt_id,scoring_revision_no,settlement_revision_no,settlement_snapshot, entry_direct_ability,evidence_count,aggregate_evidence_value,positive_ratio,negative_ratio, effective_impact_coefficient,tentative_direct_ability,final_direct_ability,status,rule_version_id,request_id,settled_time) values(#{id},#{item.userId},#{item.goalId},#{item.examSubjectId},#{knowledgePointId},'single',#{item.sessionId}, #{attemptId},1,1,'{"schema_version":"knowledge_practice_settlement/1.0"}'::jsonb, coalesce((select current_direct_ability from cm_knowledge_profile where user_id=#{item.userId} and goal_id=#{item.goalId} and knowledge_point_id=#{knowledgePointId}),50),1, case when #{correct} then 85 else 25 end,case when #{correct} then 1 else 0 end, case when #{correct} then 0 else 1 end,1, (coalesce((select current_direct_ability from cm_knowledge_profile where user_id=#{item.userId} and goal_id=#{item.goalId} and knowledge_point_id=#{knowledgePointId}),50)*3+ case when #{correct} then 85 else 25 end)/4, (coalesce((select current_direct_ability from cm_knowledge_profile where user_id=#{item.userId} and goal_id=#{item.goalId} and knowledge_point_id=#{knowledgePointId}),50)*3+ case when #{correct} then 85 else 25 end)/4,'settled',#{item.ruleVersionId},#{requestId},now()) on conflict(source_attempt_id,knowledge_point_id,scoring_revision_no) where settlement_type='single' do update set id=cm_profile_settlement.id returning id
mapper.insert: insert into cm_learning_evidence(id,settlement_id,user_id,goal_id,session_id,attempt_id, exam_subject_id,knowledge_point_id,evidence_group_key,behavior_type,difficulty_snapshot,score_rate, raw_evidence_value,direction,hint_level,elapsed_seconds,timer_status,hint_coefficient,time_coefficient, combined_coefficient,behavior_coefficient,streak_coefficient,is_distinct_question,is_valid,rule_version_id, answered_at,effective_at,settlement_sequence) values(#{id},#{settlementId},#{item.userId},#{item.goalId},#{item.sessionId},#{attemptId},#{item.examSubjectId}, #{knowledgePointId},#{item.evidenceGroupKey},'knowledge_practice',#{item.difficultySnapshot}, case when #{correct} then 1 else 0 end,case when #{correct} then 85 else 25 end, case when #{correct} then 'positive' else 'negative' end,'none',null,'missing',1,1,1,1,1, not exists(select 1 from cm_learning_evidence e where e.user_id=#{item.userId} and e.goal_id=#{item.goalId} and e.knowledge_point_id=#{knowledgePointId} and e.evidence_group_key=#{item.evidenceGroupKey} and e.is_valid=true and e.is_distinct_question=true),true,#{item.ruleVersionId},now(),now(), coalesce((select max(e.settlement_sequence)+1 from cm_learning_evidence e where e.user_id=#{item.userId} and e.goal_id=#{item.goalId} and e.knowledge_point_id=#{knowledgePointId}),1)) on conflict(attempt_id,knowledge_point_id) where is_valid=true do nothing
mapper.select: with recursive active as ( select kp.id,kp.parent_id,kp.importance from cm_knowledge_point kp join cm_user_goal g on g.syllabus_version_id=kp.syllabus_version_id and g.id=#{goalId} where kp.del_flag='0' and kp.status='0' ), parents as (select * from active where exists(select 1 from active c where c.parent_id=active.id)), leaves as (select * from active where not exists(select 1 from active c where c.parent_id=active.id)), closure as ( select p.id parent_id,c.id descendant_id from parents p join active c on c.parent_id=p.id union all select cl.parent_id,c.id from closure cl join active c on c.parent_id=cl.descendant_id ), mapped as ( select distinct cl.parent_id,l.id leaf_id,l.importance from closure cl join leaves l on l.id=cl.descendant_id ) select m.parent_id knowledge_point_id, sum(p.current_direct_ability*m.importance)/nullif(sum(m.importance),0) ability, count(p.id)::int assessed_leaf_count, case when count(p.id)=0 then 'unassessed' when bool_and(p.confidence_level in('medium','high')) then 'medium' else 'low' end confidence, case when count(p.id)=0 then 'unassessed' when sum(p.current_direct_ability*m.importance)/nullif(sum(m.importance),0)<40 then 'urgent' when sum(p.current_direct_ability*m.importance)/nullif(sum(m.importance),0)<60 then 'weak' when sum(p.current_direct_ability*m.importance)/nullif(sum(m.importance),0)<75 then 'learning' when sum(p.current_direct_ability*m.importance)/nullif(sum(m.importance),0)<85 then 'proficient' else 'mastery_candidate' end status from mapped m left join cm_knowledge_profile p on p.knowledge_point_id=m.leaf_id and p.user_id=#{userId} and p.goal_id=#{goalId} group by m.parent_id order by m.parent_id
mapper.insert: insert into cm_knowledge_profile(id,user_id,goal_id,knowledge_point_id,current_direct_ability,confidence_level, profile_status,distinct_question_count,recent_trend,rule_version_id,calculated_time) values(#{id},#{userId},#{goalId},#{aggregate.knowledgePointId},#{aggregate.ability},#{aggregate.confidence}, #{aggregate.status},#{aggregate.assessedLeafCount},'stable',#{ruleVersionId},now()) on conflict(user_id,goal_id,knowledge_point_id) do update set current_direct_ability=excluded.current_direct_ability, confidence_level=excluded.confidence_level,profile_status=excluded.profile_status, distinct_question_count=excluded.distinct_question_count,rule_version_id=excluded.rule_version_id, calculated_time=now(),row_version=cm_knowledge_profile.row_version+1,update_time=now()
mapper.update: update cm_subject_profile sp set knowledge_aggregate_score=x.ability,subject_ability=x.ability,target_coverage_rate=x.coverage, medium_high_coverage_rate=x.confident_coverage,confidence_level=x.confidence, rule_version_id=#{ruleVersionId},calculated_time=now(),row_version=sp.row_version+1,update_time=now() from (select kp.exam_subject_id, sum(p.current_direct_ability*kp.importance)/nullif(sum(kp.importance),0) ability, count(p.id)::numeric/nullif(count(*)::numeric,0) coverage, count(p.id) filter(where p.confidence_level in('medium','high'))::numeric/nullif(count(*)::numeric,0) confident_coverage, case when count(p.id)=0 then 'unassessed' when bool_and(p.confidence_level in('medium','high')) then 'medium' else 'low' end confidence from cm_knowledge_point kp left join cm_knowledge_profile p on p.knowledge_point_id=kp.id and p.user_id=#{userId} and p.goal_id=#{goalId} where kp.del_flag='0' and kp.status='0' and not exists(select 1 from cm_knowledge_point c where c.parent_id=kp.id and c.del_flag='0' and c.status='0') group by kp.exam_subject_id) x where sp.user_id=#{userId} and sp.goal_id=#{goalId} and sp.exam_subject_id=x.exam_subject_id

update cm_overall_profile op set overall_ability=x.ability,rule_version_id=#{ruleVersionId},calculated_time=now(), row_version=op.row_version+1,update_time=now() from (select sum(p.current_direct_ability*kp.importance)/nullif(sum(kp.importance),0) ability from cm_knowledge_point kp join cm_knowledge_profile p on p.knowledge_point_id=kp.id where p.user_id=#{userId} and p.goal_id=#{goalId} and kp.del_flag='0' and kp.status='0' and not exists(select 1 from cm_knowledge_point c where c.parent_id=kp.id and c.del_flag='0' and c.status='0')) x where op.user_id=#{userId} and op.goal_id=#{goalId}
mapper.select: select count(*) from cm_question_attempt a join cm_session_question sq on sq.id=a.session_question_id where sq.session_id=#{sessionId} and a.status='submitted'
mapper.update: update cm_learning_session set started_time=coalesce(started_time,now()),status='submitted', submitted_time=coalesce(submitted_time,now()),status_changed_time=now(),update_time=now() where id=#{sessionId} and user_id=#{userId} and session_type in ('self_practice','reinforcement_practice') and status in('created','in_progress')

update cm_learning_session set status='settling',status_changed_time=now(),update_time=now() where id=#{sessionId} and user_id=#{userId} and session_type in ('self_practice','reinforcement_practice') and status='submitted'

update cm_learning_session set status='completed',settled_time=coalesce(settled_time,now()), status_changed_time=now(),update_time=now() where id=#{sessionId} and user_id=#{userId} and session_type in ('self_practice','reinforcement_practice') and status='settling'
mapper.insert: insert into cm_reinforcement_round(id,user_id,source_session_id,source_question_order,source_question_id, source_evidence_group_key,source_difficulty,goal_id,syllabus_version_id,exam_subject_id,round_no,status, knowledge_snapshot,source_presentation_snapshot,source_correct,recommendation_reason,recommendation_source, estimated_count) select #{id},s.user_id,s.id,sq.question_order,sq.question_id,sq.evidence_group_key, coalesce(sq.difficulty_snapshot,'medium'),s.goal_id,s.syllabus_version_id,sq.exam_subject_id,1,'READY', sq.knowledge_snapshot,sq.presentation_snapshot,#{correct}, case when #{correct} then '点击开始强化后，将生成学习建议并从题库抽取同知识点题目。' else '点击开始强化后，将生成学习建议并从题库抽取同知识点题目。' end, 'RULE',3 from cm_learning_session s join cm_session_question sq on sq.session_id=s.id where s.id=#{sessionId} and s.user_id=#{userId} and s.session_type='self_practice' and sq.question_order=#{questionOrder} on conflict(user_id,source_session_id,source_question_order,round_no) do nothing
mapper.select: select id,user_id,source_session_id,source_question_order,source_question_id,source_evidence_group_key, source_difficulty,goal_id,syllabus_version_id,exam_subject_id,round_no,previous_round_id, reinforcement_session_id,status,knowledge_snapshot::text,source_presentation_snapshot::text, source_correct,recommendation_reason,recommendation_source,estimated_count,request_id,error_code from cm_reinforcement_round where user_id=#{userId} and source_session_id=#{sessionId} and source_question_order=#{questionOrder} order by round_no desc limit 1

select id,user_id,source_session_id,source_question_order,source_question_id,source_evidence_group_key, source_difficulty,goal_id,syllabus_version_id,exam_subject_id,round_no,previous_round_id, reinforcement_session_id,status,knowledge_snapshot::text,source_presentation_snapshot::text, source_correct,recommendation_reason,recommendation_source,estimated_count,request_id,error_code from cm_reinforcement_round where id=#{roundId} and user_id=#{userId}

select id,user_id,source_session_id,source_question_order,source_question_id,source_evidence_group_key, source_difficulty,goal_id,syllabus_version_id,exam_subject_id,round_no,previous_round_id, reinforcement_session_id,status,knowledge_snapshot::text,source_presentation_snapshot::text, source_correct,recommendation_reason,recommendation_source,estimated_count,request_id,error_code from cm_reinforcement_round where id=#{roundId} and user_id=#{userId} for update
mapper.update: update cm_reinforcement_round set status=#{status},recommendation_reason=#{reason}, recommendation_source=#{source},estimated_count=#{estimatedCount},error_code=#{errorCode},update_time=now() where id=#{roundId} and status in ('PREPARING','READY')
update cm_reinforcement_round set status='DISMISSED',update_time=now() where id=#{roundId} and user_id=#{userId} and status='READY'
mapper.select: with targets as ( select (x->>'knowledgePointId')::bigint id from jsonb_array_elements(#{round.knowledgeSnapshot}::jsonb->'items') x where coalesce(x->>'relationRole','tested')='tested' ), latest as ( select distinct on (r.question_id) r.* from cm_question_revision r where r.status='published' order by r.question_id,r.revision_no desc,r.id desc ), ranked as ( select q.id question_id,r.id revision_id,r.question_type,coalesce(r.difficulty,'medium') difficulty, r.estimated_seconds,r.stem,r.analysis,r.answer::text answer_json,q.evidence_group_key, count(distinct qk.knowledge_point_id)::int knowledge_overlap from cm_question q join latest r on r.question_id=q.id join cm_question_knowledge qk on qk.question_id=q.id and qk.question_revision_id=r.id join targets t on t.id=qk.knowledge_point_id where q.del_flag='0' and q.id<>#{round.sourceQuestionId} and coalesce(nullif(btrim(q.evidence_group_key),''),concat('Q:',q.id))<>#{round.sourceEvidenceGroupKey} and qk.exam_subject_id=#{round.examSubjectId} and and not exists ( select 1 from cm_question_attempt a join cm_session_question done_sq on done_sq.id=a.session_question_id join cm_learning_session done_s on done_s.id=done_sq.session_id where a.user_id=#{round.userId} and a.status='submitted' and done_s.goal_id=#{round.goalId} and done_s.syllabus_version_id=#{round.syllabusVersionId} and done_sq.question_id=q.id) and not exists ( select 1 from cm_reinforcement_round rr join cm_session_question used on used.session_id=rr.reinforcement_session_id where rr.user_id=#{round.userId} and rr.source_session_id=#{round.sourceSessionId} and rr.source_question_order=#{round.sourceQuestionOrder} and used.question_id=q.id) group by q.id,r.id,r.question_type,r.difficulty,r.estimated_seconds,r.stem,r.analysis,r.answer,q.evidence_group_key ) select ranked.question_id,ranked.revision_id,#{round.examSubjectId} exam_subject_id, coalesce(nullif(btrim(ranked.evidence_group_key),''),concat('Q:',ranked.question_id)) evidence_group_key, ranked.question_type,ranked.difficulty,ranked.estimated_seconds,ranked.stem,ranked.analysis,ranked.answer_json, coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('label',o.option_label,'content',o.option_text,'sortOrder',o.sort_order) order by o.sort_order,o.id) from cm_question_option o where o.question_revision_id=ranked.revision_id),'[]')::text options_json, coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('sourceUrl',im.source_url,'storagePath',im.storage_path,'altText',im.alt_text,'sortOrder',im.image_order) order by im.image_order,im.id) from cm_question_image im where im.question_revision_id=ranked.revision_id),'[]')::text images_json, coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('knowledgePointId',kp.id::text,'knowledgePointName',kp.syllabus_title,'examSubjectId',kp.exam_subject_id::text,'relationRole','tested','sortOrder',kp.sort_order) order by kp.id) from cm_question_knowledge all_qk join cm_knowledge_point kp on kp.id=all_qk.knowledge_point_id where all_qk.question_revision_id=ranked.revision_id and kp.syllabus_version_id=#{round.syllabusVersionId} and kp.del_flag='0' and kp.status='0'),'[]')::text knowledge_json, '{}'::text grading_rules_json,1.00 max_score,ranked.knowledge_overlap, abs((case ranked.difficulty when 'easy' then 1 when 'medium' then 2 when 'hard' then 3 else 2 end)- (case #{round.sourceDifficulty} when 'easy' then 1 when 'medium' then 2 when 'hard' then 3 else 2 end)) difficulty_distance from ranked order by knowledge_overlap desc,difficulty_distance,question_id limit 3
mapper.insert: insert into cm_learning_session(id,user_id,goal_id,exam_subject_id,session_type,status,rule_version_id,request_id, certification_id,syllabus_version_id,target_exam_year,target_exam_month,row_version) select #{id},#{round.userId},g.id,#{round.examSubjectId},'reinforcement_practice','created',#{ruleVersionId},#{requestId}, g.certification_id,g.syllabus_version_id,g.target_exam_year,g.target_exam_month,0 from cm_user_goal g where g.id=#{round.goalId} and g.user_id=#{round.userId} and g.status='active' and g.syllabus_version_id=#{round.syllabusVersionId}
mapper.update: update cm_reinforcement_round set status='STARTED',reinforcement_session_id=#{sessionId}, request_id=#{requestId},estimated_count=#{count},update_time=now() where id=#{roundId} and user_id=#{userId} and status='READY'
update cm_reinforcement_round set status='COMPLETED',completed_time=now(),update_time=now() where reinforcement_session_id=#{sessionId} and user_id=#{userId} and status='STARTED'
mapper.insert: insert into cm_reinforcement_round(id,user_id,source_session_id,source_question_order,source_question_id, source_evidence_group_key,source_difficulty,goal_id,syllabus_version_id,exam_subject_id,round_no, previous_round_id,status,knowledge_snapshot,source_presentation_snapshot,source_correct, recommendation_reason,recommendation_source,request_id) values(#{id},#{previous.userId},#{previous.sourceSessionId},#{previous.sourceQuestionOrder},#{previous.sourceQuestionId}, #{previous.sourceEvidenceGroupKey},#{previous.sourceDifficulty},#{previous.goalId},#{previous.syllabusVersionId}, #{previous.examSubjectId},#{previous.roundNo}+1,#{previous.id},'READY',#{previous.knowledgeSnapshot}::jsonb, #{previous.sourcePresentationSnapshot}::jsonb,#{previous.sourceCorrect},#{previous.recommendationReason}, #{previous.recommendationSource},#{requestId}) on conflict do nothing
mapper.select: select sq.question_order,true submitted,coalesce(aa.score_rate=1,false) correct from cm_reinforcement_round rr join cm_session_question sq on sq.session_id=rr.reinforcement_session_id left join cm_question_attempt a on a.session_question_id=sq.id and a.user_id=rr.user_id and a.status='submitted' left join cm_attempt_answer aa on aa.attempt_id=a.id where rr.id=#{roundId} order by sq.question_order
